objective: Research current top frontend UI/UX best practices (baseline-aware against what this dashboard already ships), then implement only NEW fitting DOs in the vanilla zero-build dashboard; verified no-op is an allowed outcome per finding.
constraints: KEEP_VANILLA: no frameworks/libraries/bundlers (no React/Tailwind/GSAP/anime.js/htmx); npm only for prettier/eslint/tsc
18 getElementById hooks + STATE_KEY "gate-earn-dashboard-v1" (app.js:8) must remain intact (grep-verified)
app.js effectively frozen: prefer CSS/HTML-only fixes; JS-touching findings need explicit justification (high-risk, likely SKIP)
prefers-reduced-motion kill-switch (~styles.css:2247+) must cover ALL motion
if any motion touched: single ease token cubic-bezier(0.2,0.8,0.2,1) (styles.css:50); one orchestrated load moment (dial-draw) only; budget <=800ms
lift policy: ONLY .top3-card (~styles.css:866) and .pws-link (~styles.css:2024) may translateY(-1px); nothing else gains a lift
no will-change sprinkling, no animation-timeline, no scattered hover-lift
a11y first-class: 44px min targets, focus-visible gold ring (styles.css:132-135), keyboard operability, WCAG AA contrast
ASCII-only edits except existing Rs (rupee) symbol
out of scope: date changes, color-scheme logic changes, content/copy rewrites, visual redesign of the brand (gold/dark Gate Earn identity stays)
verification allowed: npx prettier --check index.html styles.css app.js; npx tsc --allowJs --checkJs false --noEmit app.js; npx eslint app.js; git status/diff/log/add/commit
verification DENIED: node --check, stylelint, python, &&-chained commands
stage explicit file paths only; never .engram/ or node_modules/

conventions.do_skip_contract: Only NEW findings carry actionable DO or SKIP verdicts with fit/skip rationale; SKIP must name the violated constraint or reason
conventions.labeling: exactly DONE-BASELINE | SKIP-BASELINE | NEW (then DO|SKIP only for NEW)
conventions.finding_ids: this plan uses U1, U2, ... ; prior motion findings keep F1-F18 / N1-N5 IDs and are never renumbered
conventions.evidence_rule: every claim needs a file:line citation; already-ships claims cite this working tree; source claims cite absolute URLs
conventions.stage_policy: explicit file paths only; never .engram/ or node_modules/
conventions.ascii: ASCII-only edits except existing Rs (rupee) symbol
conventions.user_pattern: research wave -> implement wave -> review gate -> commit (push only via ask)

prior findings are baseline: prior shipped DOs marked DONE-BASELINE (cite file:line); prior SKIPs marked SKIP-BASELINE (reuse original skip rationale); only NEW UI/UX findings are actionable DO/SKIP; do not relitigate without new evidence
pure vanilla, 3 files, zero build; npm only for prettier/eslint/tsc
18 getElementById hooks + STATE_KEY gate-earn-dashboard-v1 (app.js:8) effectively frozen; prefer CSS/HTML-only; JS-touching findings high-risk (likely SKIP)
scattered hover lifts killed; only .top3-card (~styles.css:866) and .pws-link (~styles.css:2024) retain translateY(-1px)

gold/dark Gate Earn identity, dates, color-scheme logic, and copy are hard out of scope

shipped_motion_do_baseline: F11 moz range thumb hover/transition parity
F15 :active press on timeline weeks (no lift)
prior_skips_do_not_relitigate: 10 motion SKIPs from F1-F18 set (original rationales reused)
N5 no hero glow pulse / preloader
scope_uiux: content readability (structure only - not copy rewrites)
out_of_scope: visual redesign of the brand (gold/dark Gate Earn identity stays)
research_digest.output_contract: findings.md: each item has title, sources (absolute URLs), baseline status (DONE-BASELINE | SKIP-BASELINE | NEW), DO|SKIP (NEW only), fit/skip rationale, re-validated file:line target, reduced-motion/collision note, risk

reuse_notes.tdd_red_first: grep proving absence before each edit; green verification after
reuse_notes.gate_npx_policy: sandbox may deny npx - prettier/tsc may cite implementer evidence; greps re-checked independently; eslint re-run if possible

plan_summary: 3 waves, 3 tasks, 2 contracts: uiux-research-2 (wave 1, gem-researcher, read-only, baseline-aware UI/UX research -> findings.md with U-IDs) -> uiux-implement-2 (wave 2, gem-implementer, implement only NEW DOs or verified no-op, all hard constraints binding) -> gate-ship-2 (wave 3, gem-reviewer, full-diff review vs acceptance, re-run verification, evidence_rule file:line, commit 20260923-ui-ux-best-practices_wave-3 with explicit paths, push = ask only).
